[b][size=xx-large][color=#ffffff][u]Hack Forum News - Edition 66[/u][/color][/size][/b]

[b]Welcome back to another Hack Forum News edition. Where we keep you up to date on the weekly events and news happening on site and around the world. If you have never heard of the Hack Forum News, don't worry, we have you covered. We are a team of members from the Hack Forums community who are journalists and writers, and we are here to keep you in the loop of the changes around the site and the events happening around the world.[/b]

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6332091][color=#ffffff]Attachments Disabled[/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=1]

Attachments were disabled for a few days while some security updates where taken care of, they have recently been enabled again but there is still lots of testing to do. If you notice anything unusual please report it in the original thread.

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6332064][color=#ffffff]Scrolling Ads Live[/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=1]

Scrolling Ads are now officially live the current price is $25 per week that will adjust according to demand. You can find additional information about scrolling ads here [url=https://hackforums.net/misc.php?action=help&hid=25]Advertising and Paid Stickies.[/url] Have any questions or want to purchase a scrolling ad? Please check out the original thread for more information.

[u][b][size=large]Sony & Hideo Kojima[/size][/b][/u]

Reports emerged that Sony split with Kojima over Physint missing deadlines and budget targets, leading the project toward Xbox.

[u][b][size=large]Anti-Cheat Economics[/size][/b][/u]

Activision released a data report revealing that video game cheating has inflated into an $8.5 billion illicit industry.

[u][b][size=large]Generation 10 Pokémon Revealed[/size][/b][/u]

The Pokémon Company officially confirmed Pokémon Winds and Pokémon Waves. Slated for a late 2027 holiday launch.

[hr]

[img]https://hackforums.net/images/hfnews/tech-brown.png[/img]
[size=medium][b]Writer -[/b][/size] [mention=2331053]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]Alibaba announces a huge new AI push[/color][/size][/b][/u]

Alibaba says its next-generation model could reach 5–10 trillion parameters, alongside a new Zhenwu V900 AI chip that it says delivers roughly 3× the performance of its predecessor. The chip is expected to enter mass production in 2027.

[b][url=https://www.reuters.com/business/retail-consumer/alibaba-plans-ai-model-with-5-trillion-10-trillion-parameters-unveils-new-chip-2026-09-22]Source[/url][/b]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]Google is launching a new premium "Googlebook"[/color][/size][/b][/u]

Google has pre-orders opened at $899, with Acer, Asus, Dell, HP and Lenovo producing machines. They're built around ChromeOS/Android integration and Google's Gemini AI features, including screen understanding and cross-device workflows.

[b][url=https://www.reuters.com/business/retail-consumer/google-opens-pre-orders-899-googlebook-laptops-built-around-gemini-ai-2026-09-21]Source[/url][/b]
